title: Easy Gunpowder
description: This datapack replaces the need of hunting creepers by allowing you to put coal in a blast furnace to create gunpowder!
body:
# Easy Gunpowder With this mod, you will no longer have to hunt for creepers! **_Important Note: if there is not a file specific to your version, install the closest one. It will almost certainly work if you just ignore the "From an older version" message._** To create gunpowder, simply put coal or charcoal into a Blast Furnace (not a normal furnace) and smelt it!
**This is useful for various reasons, including: making fireworks in a flash, getting TNT, and, of course, not risking your builds to kill creepers!** ![Smelt it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88c4a2a7858bd9d4fdb5ce7e95878e61b3234ef0.png)
